scope: Disposition of the existing 184 archived names only. No repository-wide rediscovery, source edits, env values, deployment claims, or feature-retirement inference.

method.canonicalOwnerRule: Only the exact historical runtime-path to effective-source-map joins are called canonical owner evidence.
method.actualReaderRule: Only current literal references already classified as direct process.env reads are called actual readers. Other literal references are retained separately because comments, diagnostics, strings, and config-field names are not reads.
method.pm2BotGraphResult: No archived name has a direct named process.env reader in the scanned PM2 bot entry/module evidence. run-empire-v2.js injects resolved ConfigLoader snapshot fields at 1380-1389; ConfigLoader narrows bot bootstrap input to PROFILE, DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH, and BACKTEST_RUN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH at 2248-2277. None is among this archived census.
method.computedReaderAndCredentialLimit: This does not prove arbitrary dynamic external code cannot read process.env. In the examined ConfigLoader credential funnel, the bot allowlist is explicit at foundation/ConfigLoader.js:358-381 and none of these archived names is in it; retained credentials are outside this 184-name census.
